notes.title: Debug report
notes.content:
Detailed repair list:
Fixed bug that Mac version couldn't unlock.
Fixed the bug of MAC switch window stuck.
Fixed the error of fast forward function of Ctrl key.
Fixed individual typos.
Fixed wrong vocabulary in traditional Chinese version.

In addition, due to the lack of compatibility of steam library with M1 chip of MAC, users of such models may not be able to start the game.
There is no solution. We are also waiting for the official tools to be updated.
